verdict.rationale: The evidence covers annual report e-filing mechanics: payment options, processing, editable fields and amended reports. It also says dissolved entities can be reinstated by paying 'all associated fees' (florida-dos-docs-19), but no item states a filing deadline date, a late-fee amount, or a penalty or interest schedule with exact figures. Deadlines and penalties are a fair question for a state business-filing agency, so the missing evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.
